notes.title: Day One. Let the duels begin!
notes.notes:
Yippie ya yay! It's time!

Wild West Gringos takes on the duels of the world!

Whether you're alone against a computer gringo or against a friend: a decent shootout is a decent shootout. I guess there's no two opinions on that 🙂 .

So, put the bean pan aside, clean your boots and off to the duel scene!

P.S.: Some features are still in beta status. Feel free to let me know if something isn't working well yet or if you find any bugs. Thanks!

notes.title: 3 weeks left!
notes.notes:
Howdy Strangers!
Only a few weeks until release of 'Wild West Gringos'!
There are still some bugs to fix, but i am hopeful, that everything will be ready in time.
In the meantime, feel free to add 'Wild West Gringos' to your wishlist and let all your friends know.

Cheers!
